Job Summary

This position responsible to monitor equipment health status and provide technical support to ensure successful implementation of PdM execution on site area. This position also coordinate, monitor, and product analytical report of each site equipment health while liase with OEM dealers and 3rd party vendors for technical support, regular condition monitoring, and contamination control audit to ensure sustainability of improvement initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Follow all safety awareness and maintain compliance with PTP company regulation, PTP Golden Rules, safety procedures and environmental policies
Safety procedures and rules are all successfully followed and maintained.

Maintain and control equipment health data collection compliance (online and offline data) and also updates of NDT inspections (Swing Bearing, Undercarriage, Bucket, Dump Body, Chassis/ Frame)
Equipment health data collection compliance (online and offline data) and also updates of NDT inspections (Swing Bearing, Undercarriage, Bucket, Dump Body, Chassis/ Frame) are accurately maintained and controlled.

Regular review and analyze machine electronic data (Oil, Coolant, Grease, Magnetic plugs, Filter cut analysis) with recommendation action and report
Recommendation action and report regarding machine electronic data are successfully provided.

Actively liaise and involve with PdM team on analysis and recommendation follow-ups; PdM WO creation, execution priority and quality, action feedback follow-ups
PdM is thoroughly involved to execute priority and quality.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Diploma Degree of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 3 years experiences in mining industry and equipment health initiatives.
• Advanced knowledge in maintenance analytical tools (VIMS, VHMS, ET, MPro, Insite)
• Advanced knowledge of fluid and grease analysis methods (for oil, fuel, coolant, grease)
• Advanced knowledge in mechanical awareness
• Advanced understanding of heavy equipment maintenance management
• Understand material mechanical properties (basic metallurgy, mechanical failure analysis)
• Proficient lateral and analytical thinking
• Multivariate data analytical capability
• High communication skills
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

wo-jpfa-JR1195.d:
Job Summary**

Oversee and manage all service procurement activities, ensuring efficient and cost-effective acquisition of necessary services for PT Vaksindo Satwa Nusantara. This role involves supervising a team, optimizing procurement processes, and maintaining strong vendor relationships.

Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise a team of procurement specialists responsible for service purchases.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies for various services, aligning with company goals and budget constraints.
* Manage the entire service procurement cycle, from vendor selection and negotiation to contract finalization and performance monitoring.
* Identify and evaluate potential service providers, conducting due diligence and risk assessments.
* Negotiate favorable terms, conditions, and pricing with vendors to achieve cost savings and optimize value.
* Prepare and manage service contracts, ensuring compliance with legal and company policies.
* Monitor vendor performance, resolve issues, and foster strong, collaborative relationships.
* Collaborate with internal departments to understand service requirements and ensure timely and effective procurement.
* Maintain accurate records of all procurement activities, contracts, and vendor information.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement best practices in service procurement.
* Stay updated on market trends, industry regulations, and new technologies related to service procurement.
* Prepare reports on procurement performance, cost savings, and vendor management for senior leadership.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in procurement, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role, preferably in service procurement.
* Proven track record of successful negotiation and contract management.
* Strong understanding of procurement best practices, legal aspects of contracts, and vendor management.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to lead and motivate a team effectively.
* Proficiency in procurement software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

1. Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with approved formulations and perform random checks on the control systems.

2. Conduct in-process quality inspections from grinding to bagging-off stages and determine the production status (Approved, Quarantine, or Rejected).

3. Prepare and maintain daily reports on in-process quality, bagging activities, and corrective actions during operations.

4. Report quality testing results, follow up on quarantined products, and support internal audits related to production processes.

5. Maintain equipment and the work environment while implementing HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment), 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives within the QC In-Process function.

Qualifications:

• Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Food Technology, Fisheries, Animal Science, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Technology, or a related field.
• Minimum 1 year of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Production Quality, or Laboratory functions within the manufacturing, feed, food, or related industries.
• Good understanding of production processes, in-process quality control, quality testing methods, and product quality standards.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with SAP or other ERP systems is an advantage.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, detail-oriented, committed to HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) and 5S practices, and willing to be placed in Lamongan, East Java.

1. Memantau proses produksi untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan formula yang telah ditetapkan serta melakukan pengecekan acak pada sistem kontrol.

2. Melakukan inspeksi kualitas selama proses produksi mulai dari tahap grinding hingga bagging-off serta menentukan status produk (OK, Karantina, atau Reject).

3. Menyusun dan memelihara laporan harian terkait kualitas proses, aktivitas bagging, serta tindakan korektif selama operasional.

4. Melaporkan hasil pengujian kualitas, menindaklanjuti produk karantina, dan mendukung pelaksanaan audit internal terkait proses produksi.

5. Memelihara peralatan dan lingkungan kerja serta menerapkan program K3, 5S, dan inisiatif perbaikan berkelanjutan (continuous improvement) di area QC In Process.

Kualifikasi

• Minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) Teknologi Pangan, Perikanan, Peternakan, Biologi, Kimia, Teknologi Pertanian, atau jurusan terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Quality Produksi, atau Laboratorium pada industri manufaktur, pakan, pangan, atau industri terkait.
• Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai proses produksi, pengendalian mutu selama proses (in-process quality control), metode pengujian kualitas, dan standar mutu produk.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office; pengalaman menggunakan SAP atau sistem ERP lainnya menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik, teliti, berkomitmen terhadap penerapan K3 dan 5S, serta bersedia ditempatkan di Lamongan, Jawa Timur.

wo-jpfa-JR5560.d:
RINGKASAN PEKERJAAN

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk sedang mencari Henhouse Operator untuk ditempatkan di unit PS PKLN BANTENG-4. Peran ini bertanggung jawab atas operasional harian kandang ayam pembibit (parent stock), guna memastikan kesehatan, kenyamanan, dan produktivitas ayam terjaga dengan optimal sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) perusahaan serta prinsip biosekuriti yang ketat.

TANGGUNG JAWAB PEKERJAAN :

1). Mengawasi dan memastikan pemberian pakan dan air minum untuk ayam berjalan dengan lancar dan sesuai dengan takaran serta jadwal yang ditentukan.
2). Memelihara, membersihkan, dan memastikan kondisi sanitasi kandang serta lingkungan sekitarnya tetap terjaga sesuai dengan standar biosekuriti.
3). Melakukan pemantauan harian terhadap kesehatan dan perilaku ayam, serta segera melaporkan jika ditemukan adanya gejala penyakit atau ketidaknormalan.
4). Mengoperasikan dan merawat peralatan serta sistem otomatisasi di dalam kandang (seperti sistem ventilasi, pemanas, dan pencahayaan) agar berfungsi dengan baik.
5). Membantu proses pengumpulan, penyortiran, dan pencatatan data produksi telur harian.
6). Menerapkan standar Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) selama menjalankan aktivitas di area peternakan.

KUALIFIKASI PEKERJAAN :
a. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK (diutamakan jurusan Peternakan, Kesehatan Hewan, atau bidang terkait).
b. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun sebagai Operator Kandang atau di industri peternakan unggas (pengalaman di bagian Parent Stock lebih disukai). Lulusan baru dengan latar belakang pendidikan relevan dipersilakan melamar.
c. Memiliki pemahaman dasar tentang manajemen pemeliharaan ayam, kesehatan unggas, dan prosedur biosekuriti.
d. Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, pekerja keras, dan memiliki ketahanan fisik yang baik untuk bekerja di area kandang.
e. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun bekerja sama dalam tim.
f. Bersedia ditempatkan di area kerja PS PKLN BANTENG-4 dan tinggal di mess yang disediakan oleh perusahaan (jika diperlukan).
